entries.claim: The pinned Mass Ordo supplies this 67-word literal selection in the stated selection order (402, then 403, then 404), with only the explicitly bound framing exclusions or cross joins and whitespace collapse. This is a derived textual comparison, not independent transmission, completion of name slots, seasonal selection or performer evidence.
Salve Regina precedes its versicle and collect in the prayers after low Mass.

The complete antiphon follows n. 332 and the closing versicle/response n. 675, with house accents and ligatures. This edition retains Eva/exilium/genetrix spellings, devotional capitals and the separately noted pointing instead of presenting them as a diplomatic transcription of Hevae/exsilium/Genitrix. The book supplies the underlying Latin formula; it is not a 1962 Missal witness or an independent attestation of every digital-source accidental.
